Triage — first-touch grading (triage seat, session `session_01KTguWpd7WNGYTGmSNY31RL`): escalated to `needs-user-decision`, type Bug (the declared surface and its comment describe a mechanism that does not exist, and a real feeder's value is silently dropped).

Why this is the inbox and not the queue: the two fixes genuinely fork — (1) remove `logo` from `AppShellBranding` (+ the `useBranding.ts:27` feed line, + the false comment) vs (2) actually build the branding context so sidebar/navbar can read it. Option 1 shrinks a published interface; option 2 is a product enhancement — both sides sit on the manual floor, and #4830 (app-shell.mdx prose) is explicitly waiting on this ruling.

Four-prong analysis:
- **Platform long-term coherence**: two independent logo paths (AppShellBranding vs app-schema `branding.logo` read directly by AppSidebar) is one path too many; removal converges on the single real one.
- **Measured business pull**: zero — the sidebar logo renders correctly today via `AppSidebar.tsx:194`; no user-visible defect, no consumer of the declared key.
- **AI-agent error-resistance**: a key that types cleanly, is fed by real code, and silently does nothing is exactly the declare-without-enforce trap; removal makes the false affordance unwritable.
- **Startup scope discipline**: remove beats declare-and-maintain; option 2 creates a permanent context-provider obligation with no demand behind it.

**Recommendation: option 1 (remove), all four prongs align** — but the published-surface deletion is yours to call. Ruling here also unblocks #4830.

Container & model: M, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` — `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --tier <paths>` on this surface returns **no path-derived mandate**, so the tier is this seat's call: floor sonnet, taken to opus because the card deletes a key from a published interface.
Clause-②: yes — deleting `logo` from the published `AppShellBranding` changes what a consumer may write against `@object-ui/layout`'s type surface. Judged from card content, not paths.
Serial constraints cleared: `packages/layout` has no in-flight claim and no open sibling card in this round's batch (#5214 holds `fields`/`auth`/`mobile`/`collaboration`/`permissions`/`providers`; #5356 holds `packages/app-shell/src/preview`; #5126 holds `skills/objectui/**`; #5343 holds `content/docs/guide/**`). No overlap.

**Ruling is settled — ⛔ not re-litigable.** Maintainer, 2026-08-19, verbatim 「全部接受」 over the 27-card decision-inbox review (comment 5339695386): **option 1, remove.** Delete the key, delete the false `passed to sidebar/navbar via context` comment, delete the dead feed line. Option 2 (build a real branding context) is rejected. The single real logo path stays the app schema's `branding.logo`, read directly by `AppSidebar.tsx:194`.

## Correction to the card's file surface — measured on `origin/main` `bdf8cf76e`, 2026-08-20

The card names **one** feeder (`apps/console/src/hooks/useBranding.ts:27`). There are **two**. The second is in-package and the card never mentions it:

```
packages/layout/src/AppSchemaRenderer.tsx:579-583
  const branding: AppShellBranding = {
    title: schema.title,
    favicon: schema.favicon,
    logo: schema.logo,
  };
```

This one fails loud (excess property on an object literal annotated `AppShellBranding`), so `tsc` will find it for you — but discovering it mid-task invites the wrong repair, which is to keep the key. Both feed lines go.

⚠️ **One thing to check, not to assume.** `AppSchemaRenderer` forwards `schema.logo` — a **top-level** app-schema key. `AppSidebar.tsx:194` reads `activeApp?.branding?.logo` — a **nested** one. The card's claim that "the logo already renders correctly today via the real path" was measured against the AppSidebar path. Confirm those two are actually the same value reaching the same place before you delete the forward; if they are not, you are removing a live path rather than a dead one and the ruling's premise is false for this half. In that case **stop and report** — the roll-back clause applies, the card returns to `needs-user-decision`, and ⛔ you do not decide it yourself.

Also update `packages/layout/README.md:82`, whose `branding` row already lists exactly the four keys that are really read — it needs no content change, but re-read it to confirm it does not gain a stale mention.

## Versioning

Changeset is **`minor`** for `@object-ui/layout`. ⛔ **Never `major`** — maintainer, 2026-08-19, verbatim: 「objectui ui 的 major 是要跟着 objectstack 走的,不可以自己发 major」. Say in the changeset body that a published optional key is removed and name the real replacement path.

Landing this unblocks **#4830** (app-shell.mdx prose). ⛔ Do not write that prose here — file surface breach; #4830 is its own card and returns to the queue when this merges.

**File-surface amendment to the round-18 claim** (session `session_01RV6yuVCxymHYE16PL9vQkE`, branch `claude/issue-4818-appshellbranding-logo`, PR #5366). Filed in the same round as the change it covers, per the bounded in-place-fix clause.

The claim declared four files. The implementation touches **five**. The added one:

```
packages/app-shell/src/layout/ConsoleLayout.tsx:174   logo: activeApp.branding.logo,
```

This is a **third** feed line into `AppShellBranding.logo`. The card named one (`apps/console/src/hooks/useBranding.ts:27`); the claim's own correction added a second (`packages/layout/src/AppSchemaRenderer.tsx:582`) and stated the card named "one" where there were "two". Measured: there were three. The third is named nowhere — not on the card, not in the triage comment, not in the claim.

**Why it was fixed in place rather than deferred.** It is not severable from the ruling: deleting the key makes that line a hard `tsc` error, so leaving it would ship `packages/app-shell` red. Measured with the key removed and the feeds intact:

```
packages/app-shell  src/layout/ConsoleLayout.tsx(174,15): error TS2322: ... Object literal may
  only specify known properties, and 'logo' does not exist in type 'AppShellBranding'.
```

Against the four conditions: (1) identical defect class — a dead `logo:` forward into `AppShellBranding`; (2) mechanical, with the correct shape pinned by the ruling and by its two sibling feed lines; (3) no other holder — no sibling worktree diff and no open PR touches this file, and round 18's only `packages/app-shell` holding is #5356 on `packages/app-shell/src/preview`, a different directory; (4) same gate family — `type-check` and the root vitest run, no new verification surface. The fix is named with its evidence in PR #5366's body.

Also within the declared surface but worth stating: `apps/console/src/hooks/useBranding.ts` loses two lines, not one — the feed at `:27` and the matching `logo?: string` at `:17` on its local `AppBranding` interface, as the dispatch specified.

`packages/layout/README.md` was re-read and is **unchanged**: its `branding` row already lists exactly the four keys really read, so it gains no stale mention.
